This directory contains wa-sqlite from commit `96d91182bf958d1c9fce2d851f66198378d8dbf1` of https://github.com/rhashimoto/wa-sqlite.

The media reviewer uses the Asyncify runtime and IDBBatchAtomicVFS. The bundled runtime is built into the offline HTML; it is not downloaded when the application runs. The upstream MIT license is included in LICENSE.
